All new endpoints (channel-info, find-channel, messages, react, relationships, active-threads) correctly validate input (400) and return clean JSON (ok:false, status 401) with FAKE.TOKEN.xyz — never HTTP 500. ui_bugs.issue: Race between the hydration useEffect (line 249) and the per-field save useEffects (line 306 for mask, likely similar for others). On mount both effects run; the save effect fires with the stale DEFAULT_MASK closure AFTER hydratedRef flips to true inside the load effect, overwriting the just-loaded value in LS. Repro: toggle mask-shuffle ON (LS={shuffle:true}), reload page — LS becomes {shuffle:false} even before re-entering the panel, and aria-checked reads false on mount.

action_items: Fix mask (and likely alerts/quiet/templates/backups/session) localStorage hydration race in App.js: either (a) use lazy init in useState so DEFAULT values start from LS synchronously, or (b) set hydratedRef.current = true BEFORE calling setMask in the load effect AND skip the very first run of each save effect using an additional per-key ref, or (c) call all setters first then set hydratedRef in a microtask after state has committed.
LLM budget for EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is still a concern (from it1) — not retested here.

rca of the issue: RCA (mask persistence race): In App.js, state is initialized with DEFAULT_MASK (line 230). An effect at line 249 reads LS and calls setMask(loaded) THEN sets hydratedRef.current=true (line 266). The sibling save effect at line 306 runs after the load effect on the same mount tick; its [mask] closure still captures DEFAULT_MASK (setMask is async), hydratedRef is already true, so it writes DEFAULT_MASK to LS — overwriting the user's saved value. The subsequent re-render triggered by setMask SHOULD run save again with the loaded value, but in practice the LS ends up with defaults (observed: LS={shuffle:false} immediately after reload, before re-entering panel). Fix: use lazy useState init that reads LS synchronously, OR gate every save effect on an initial-render ref (e.g., firstRunRef) in addition to hydratedRef.
